metadata.title: Daniel Curran Finders International - Todays Wills & Probate Podcast
metadata.author: Daniel Curran
metadata.shortDescription:
Daniel Curran MD, Finders International joins Today’s Wills and Probate podcast host David Opie. 

Finders International recently celebrated its 25th Anniversary and in this podcast Daniel Curran discusses the challenges of running a business that has seen so much change since 1997, the changing face of genealogy services and what he thinks the future holds.

Source: 
https://todayswillsandprobate.co.uk/the-finders-international-story/ 

Connect: 
https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielcurran-finders/ 
https://www.twitter.com/Curran_Finders
